name: Alien Invasion Tower Defense 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Alien Invasion Tower Defense is a very addicting, highly tactical, fast paced tower defense game that pits you against increasingly difficult alien combatants. Strategy come into play during every level as you must choose the best place to build one of four different weapons and objects so they do the most damage and stop your enemies in their tracks.
